description: Gives the last day of the City of Toronto published review time for a complete building permit application, by review stream. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/toronto-permit-review-time-calculator?stream=house&date=2026-12-01&zoning_certificate=yes

date.description: Date the complete application is taken in (YYYY-MM-DD)

stream.description: Review stream: house = House Stream (10 business days); small = Small Building Stream (15); large = Large and Complex, large building (20); complex = Large and Complex, complex building (30); express = Express Services (goal of 3)

zoning_certificate.description: Application includes an issued Zoning Applicable Law Certificate and all fees paid

name: toronto-permit-review-time-calculator
title: Toronto permit review time calculator
